name: subagent-routing-kit
description: Hard-rule guard and delegation policy for Agent/Task subagent calls, ported from the agent-neutral subagent-routing-kit core. Blocks calls whose observable model has no capability-snapshot entry or whose observable effort is not advertised for that model. Agents the hook cannot see (built-in, managed, CLI, plugin) and omitted/inherited models are not judged. See the bundled README for the full list of what this does and does not check.
